item.title: 5.0.9-beta.1
item.description:
ExtraDock 5.0.9 (Beta 1) - Folders Open Beside the Dock! 📂✨

🔁 Build 65 (Sep 15)

  • DockFlow preset switches no longer get lost during a Dock restart: When DockFlow applies a preset, macOS restarts the native Dock and ExtraDock briefly repairs its panels - a Talk request arriving in that window used to be answered "unavailable" for every dock, so the preset silently did nothing! ExtraDock now retries the unavailable docks every 200 ms for up to about three seconds, and the newest request always wins. Pair it with DockFlow B1.82 build 4.
  • Export Performance Diagnostics: Settings → Diagnostics has a new Export Performance Diagnostics… button! Use it while a slowdown or battery drain is happening: it records ExtraDock's own CPU, memory, wakeups and disk activity for about ten seconds, adds power source, Low Power Mode, thermal state and an anonymous summary of your dock setup, and attaches the last 15 minutes of performance-related ExtraDock logs. You choose where to save the file - nothing is uploaded.
  • Log exports show their real time coverage: The five-hour log export now checks entry dates and reports the actual first and last timestamps it contains, so a report can no longer claim a window it does not cover!
  • Please test: With DockFlow B1.82 build 4 connected through Talk, switch between presets that show and hide ExtraDock docks five or six times in a row - every switch should land, including right after the macOS Dock restarts! Then run Export Performance Diagnostics… during normal use, check the saved file lists ten samples plus recent logs, and try Cancel once to confirm nothing is saved.

🔁 Build 64 (Sep 14)

  • App Connections replaces the Talk section: Settings → Integrations now shows App Connections with clear states - nothing connected, an app wants to connect, pairing in progress with a countdown, and the list of allowed apps with Permissions… and Remove… - using the same wording as ExtraDock 4 and DockFlow!
  • One-click connect from DockFlow: When DockFlow asks to connect, ExtraDock comes forward on App Connections with the requested permissions already ticked! Nothing pairs until you click Start Pairing.
  • Simpler approval window: The "Allow Access to ExtraDock" panel is smaller, shows the verification code in groups of four and uses Allow / Don't Allow! Only a matching code proves you are connecting to the right app.
  • Disabled docks are listed too: Connected apps now see every dock you own, including disabled ones (marked as disabled), so DockFlow presets can include them without pretending they can be shown!
  • Please test: In DockFlow use Connect… on ExtraDock - ExtraDock should come forward on App Connections with permissions pre-ticked and pair only after you click Start Pairing! Compare the full code in both apps before Allow, then relaunch both and confirm the connection still shows as Allowed.

✨ What's New

  • Browse pinned folders beside the dock: Click a pinned folder and its contents open right next to the icon in Grid, List or a curved Fan layout! Double-click opens files or enters subfolders, Back / Command-Up stops at the pinned folder, and you can drag files in from Finder or out to it. Browser drags always copy, so nothing moves by accident - use Cut and Paste to move.
  • Per-folder view options: Each pinned folder remembers its own click behavior (Browse or Open in Finder), layout, icon size (24–96 pt), grid columns (3–8), grid names, hidden files, sort by name / kind / date modified, reverse order and folders first! View Options live inside the browser and in the folder settings, and they import from ExtraDock 4.
  • App Stack file browser: Single-click selects, double-click opens, Command-click and Shift-click build multi-selections, and arrow keys move the selection! Right-click for native actions: Open / Open With, Get Info, Quick Look, Share, Tags, Copy Path, Rename, Duplicate, Compress, Copy / Cut / Paste and Move to Trash. Drag groups of files within the stack or to and from Finder - existing files are never silently replaced.
  • App Stack grid size: Choose 3×3 up to 8×8 per stack (default 4×4), independent of icon density! Large folders scroll instead of clipping.
  • Monitor Dock preset: The Manager's Items plus menu has a new Monitor Dock command below Native Dock Copy! One click adds CPU, Memory, GPU, Battery, IP Address and Bluetooth Battery, keeps what is already there and skips duplicates.
  • IP widget adapters, local and public together: Choose Public, Local or Both, pick one or more adapters by their macOS interface name, and see labeled addresses in horizontal and vertical docks! A disconnected adapter shows as disconnected instead of silently switching, and Copy only ever copies a valid address.
  • DockFlow over Talk (beta): ExtraDock can share its dock list and let DockFlow show, hide or toggle docks through the Talk SDK, with explicit pairing and per-scope consent under Settings → Integrations → Talk! The existing App Group bridge keeps running; DockFlow chooses which path it uses.

⚡ Improvements

  • Native Dock spacers in Live Dock: Regular and small spacers from your macOS Dock now appear as gaps in the Live Dock at the right positions and follow size changes, moves, additions and removals live! Native Dock Copy imports folder/file-section spacers as Spacer widgets without duplicating the apps-section gaps.
  • Saved App Stack names everywhere: A custom stack name (for example “Design”) now shows in the Manager's items list and in the dock hover label! Clear it to restore the default title.

🧪 Please Test

  • Folder browser: Open Grid / List / Fan on an existing and a new pinned folder, change view options, relaunch and confirm they persist; drag files in and out; try autohide and hover-collapse docks and a secondary display.
  • App Stack: Multi-select, right-click actions, drag a group to Finder, and copy a duplicate filename (it should report an error, never overwrite).
  • Live Dock: Resize or move a native Dock spacer and watch the Live Dock follow.
  • IP widget: Select Wi-Fi + Ethernet with Both, unplug and reconnect Ethernet, copy each address.
  • Talk: Pairing with DockFlow has not yet been exercised on real hardware in signed builds - report anything odd.

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.

ExtraDock 5.0.8 - Bigger Magnification, Live Icons! 🔍✨

✨ What's New

  • Bigger hover magnification: Manager → Style → Hover Magnification → Max scale now goes up to 4× (was 2.5×)! Neighboring icons slide apart around the pointer instead of overlapping, the background grows along the bar while magnified icons rise out of it like the macOS Dock, and labels, badges, running dots, previews and click targets all follow the moved icons. The 1.5× default and your saved value are unchanged.
  • Live Clock and Calendar icons: Apple's Clock shows a real analog face with moving hands, and Calendar shows today's month and date, in pinned docks, the Live Dock and Space Awareness! A custom icon on that item keeps the custom artwork.
  • Drag handle side for floating docks: Manager → Position → Floating Position → Drag handle side: Automatic, Screen edge, Inward, Left/Right (Top/Bottom for vertical docks)! Applies to the permanent handle and the hover handle; if there is no room at the chosen end, the hover handle uses the other end.
  • Reveal pinned docks before the screen edge: Behavior → Auto-Hide on a pinned dock now has Reveal when pointer is: At screen edge or Near screen edge, plus an Advanced reveal distance (Narrow / Standard / Wide)! Clicks outside the dock still reach other apps.
  • Show Manager on launch: Settings → General → Startup has the Show Manager on launch toggle back! With it off, ExtraDock starts quietly, including at login. First-run onboarding still opens the Manager.

⚡ Improvements

  • Sharper icons: App icons are rendered at full Retina resolution for the largest size they can reach under your magnification setting, so they stay crisp when zoomed! Notification badges and the attention dot now move and scale with the icon during launch bounce, attention animations and magnification.
  • Smooth magnification at every falloff radius: The falloff always reaches the neighboring icon, so moving between apps stays smooth even at the smallest Falloff radius!
  • Steadier Dock replacement: Deep-hiding the macOS Dock shows an "Updating macOS Dock…" status, re-checks itself after sleep/wake and when another utility changes Dock settings, and stops after two automatic repairs with a Retry Dock Setting button instead of looping! The info card now suggests moving the macOS Dock to an unused edge and links to Desktop & Dock settings.
  • Window previews recover on their own: Granting Screen Recording in System Settings takes effect on the next hover, no relaunch needed! Thumbnails are capped at 32 MB, cleared under memory pressure, and stale capture work is cancelled.

🐞 Bug Fixes

  • Dock survives Hide Others and Cmd+H: Option+Cmd-clicking the desktop (Finder's Hide Others) or pressing Cmd+H no longer makes the dock, hover labels and previews disappear until the next click! Settings and Manager still hide as expected.
  • Notch widgets stay readable in Light Mode: Content inside the black notch always uses dark-surface colors, so CPU, Memory, GPU and Battery values are legible regardless of the system appearance!
  • Manager launch preference is honored: The Manager no longer opens on every launch regardless of the setting!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
